All over the country, young people have been vocal about their disdain for artificial intelligence. Recent college graduation ceremonies made this very clear. Many had speakers who urged students to embrace AI. One college even had an AI system read graduates names, but any mention of AI was met with loud groans or boos from the audience. Young adults are rejecting AI, and their reasons are not only justified, but pretty unsettling.
title: Why Young People Are Rejecting AI
